server.chat.closed: This conversation was closed: {reason}. The history is saved; continue in a new conversation (POST /sessions/{id}/continue) that carries the summary.
server.chat.too_long: The message has ~{tokens} tokens and only ~{limit} fit in the context window. Split it into smaller parts.
server.context.limit_protected: the conversation reached its operational limit: its preserved facts and texts (~{protected} tokens) and the last messages no longer fit in the context window ({window} tokens)
server.context.limit: even after optimizing, the summary and the last messages do not fit in the context window ({window} tokens)
server.memory.reindex_needed: The memory was indexed with another embedding model and must be reindexed (Settings → Memory, or POST /memory/reindex). {detail}
server.calibration.dim_mismatch: the stored vectors have {stored} dimensions and the current model ({model}) produces {current}
server.calibration.model_changed: the memories were indexed with {indexed}, not with {current}
server.calibration.dedup_overlap: Paraphrases and different facts overlap with this embedding model: some duplicates will not be merged.
server.calibration.recall_overlap: Relevant and irrelevant questions overlap: some unrelated memories may enter the context.
server.calibration.false_replacements: The chat model would archive {count} still-true fact(s) (see the report). Archived memories can be restored, but consider another chat model.
server.calibration.weak_judge: The chat model recognizes few contradictions: outdated facts tend to stay active.
server.auth.too_many: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.

brand.suggestions: Remember that I live in Lisbon.
What day will it be one year from now?
web.health.title: System status
web.health.degraded_hint: Ollama unreachable or a model is missing
web.health.loading_hint: Models are not in memory: the next reply may take ~15 s
web.chat.placeholder_closed: Conversation closed: continue in a new one
web.chat.input_hint: Enter sends · Shift+Enter for a new line
web.ctx.over_window: The conversation no longer fits in the window: on the next message, the oldest messages will be summarized.
web.ctx.over_reserve: The conversation reached the space reserved for the reply: on the next message, the oldest will be summarized.
web.ctx.free_hint: When it runs out, the oldest messages are summarized on the next message
web.ctx.condensations_hint: Condensing only shortens the summary's topics; preserved facts and texts are never condensed
web.ctx.protected_hint: Your facts and texts written by the assistant, kept verbatim in the summary. When they no longer fit, the conversation is closed.
web.ctx.vram_hint: Estimate: total VRAM, minus other programs, both models and the context cache per token
web.ctx.explain: Near the limit, the oldest messages are summarized for the model automatically (the full history stays saved here). Facts, names, numbers and codes you wrote are preserved. Topics are condensed while that frees room; the conversation is only closed when the preserved facts and the last messages no longer fit in the window.
web.notice.closed: This conversation was closed: {reason}. The history is saved. Continue in a new conversation, which starts from this one's summary.
web.notice.near_limit: Conversation near its limit: preserved facts and texts already take {p}% of the context room and cannot be condensed. When they no longer fit, the conversation will be closed. If you prefer, continue in a new conversation now (it carries the summary).
web.notice.critical: Context almost full. On the next message, the oldest will be summarized automatically.
web.divider.inherited: ↪ Continuation: the model received the previous conversation's summary
web.divider.summarized: 🗜 The {n} messages above are summarized for the model
web.divider.hint: See the summary the model receives
web.mem.title: Memory
web.mem.add_placeholder: Write freely (e.g. I live in lisbon and my dog is called thor)
web.mem.optimize_hint: The model rewrites it as short, separate facts without losing details; avoids duplicates and archives what became outdated
web.mem.none: No memories yet. Say "remember that…" in the chat or add one here.
web.mem.empty_error: The memory text cannot be empty.
web.settings.title: Settings
web.settings.use_memory_hint: Looks up saved facts relevant to each message.
web.settings.use_tools_hint: The agent can save memories, check dates, etc.
web.settings.language_hint: Replies follow the language you write in.
web.settings.prefs_note: These preferences apply to the next messages and are saved in this browser.
web.cal.intro: The memory thresholds (duplicate, replacement and search) depend on the embedding model, and the replacement check depends on the chat model. When you change models, reindex and calibrate.
web.cal.threshold.dedup_hint: Above this, two facts are considered the same and not saved again.
web.cal.threshold.conflict_hint: Above this, the chat model checks whether the new fact replaces the old one.
web.cal.threshold.min_score_hint: Memories below this do not enter the conversation context.
web.cal.needs_reindex: The {n} memories must be reindexed: {reason}. Until then, memory search does not work.
web.cal.uncalibrated: default thresholds, not calibrated for this model
web.cal.confirm_reindex: Recompute the vectors of {n} memory(ies) with {model}? A JSON backup is saved first.
web.cal.reindexed: {n} memory(ies) reindexed in {s} s. Now calibrate the thresholds.
web.cal.recall: Search: {hits}/{total} questions find their fact with the suggested threshold.
web.cal.judge: Replacement: {replaced}/{contradictions} contradictions recognized, {wrong}/{compatible} true facts would be archived.
web.cal.confirm_reset: Go back to the .env default thresholds?
web.setup.title: First-run setup
web.setup.intro: Some models are missing from Ollama. Download them to get started (this happens only once).
web.setup.ollama_down: Ollama is not responding at {url}. Install and start Ollama (https://ollama.com), then check again.
web.setup.restart_hint: Restart the server so the context window is sized for your GPU.
web.auth.title: Sign in
web.auth.throttled: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
